references.text: Describes how touching unclean things makes a person unclean until evening, the same timeframe as in Leviticus 22:6
Concerns uncleanness through contact and the requirement to wash with water to become clean
Shows the same pattern: uncleanness until evening and the requirement to wash the body with water
Describes cleansing by washing clothes and the body with water, and uncleanness that lasts until evening
Immediate context dealing with priests who are unclean and must not eat of the holy offerings
Refers to cleansing the body with clean water as part of approaching God, a New Testament fulfillment of the Levitical purification rituals
